productsAndServices.description: A software platform that automates the design of electronic circuit boards from code, including schematic generation, PCB layout, and verification checks.
productsAndServices.name: JITX Electronic Systems Design Platform

productsAndServices.description: A feature that automates signal integrity constraints and optimizes pin assignments during PCB design to improve reliability and reduce design errors.
productsAndServices.name: Design Automation with Signal Integrity Optimization

productsAndServices.description: A capability that enables encapsulation of subcircuits into reusable modules for use across multiple projects, facilitating design reuse and updates.
productsAndServices.name: Modular and Reusable Circuit Design

productsAndServices.description: Automated expert-level design checks that verify circuit parameters and compliance with specifications during the design process.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Design Verification and Checks

productsAndServices.description: A tool to manage and verify replacement of out-of-stock components in designs, ensuring continued functionality and compliance.
productsAndServices.name: Supply Chain Part Substitution Management

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,616,593 to $54,387,432, a 11.78x increase.
